remarks: Welcome to your private oasis in the heart of Shippan, Stamford! This beautifully renovated ranch offers the perfect blend of charm, comfort, and modern design. Featuring two spacious bedrooms, one and a half stylish bathrooms, and a dedicated home office, this home is ideal for today's lifestyle. Step inside to an open-concept layout with gleaming hardwood floors throughout and a chef's kitchen outfitted with brand-new custom cabinetry, top-quality finishes, and an abundance of natural light. Every detail has been meticulously updated-from windows to doors to flooring-making this home completely move-in ready. Enjoy the convenience of a separate laundry area, and a detached one-car garage with ample additional parking. The flat, fenced-in backyard offers privacy and tranquility-perfect for entertaining or relaxing in your own secluded retreat. Located just a short stroll from the waterfront and local restaurants, this home combines peaceful suburban living with walkable city conveniences. Available for immediate rent-don't miss your chance to live in one of Stamford's most desirable neighborhoods!
